real_qa.q: What is the marketing maturity model that Refine Labs developed based on?
real_qa.r: Megan Bowen developed the marketing maturity assessment or marketing maturity model by taking a step back to identify patterns and observations from working with over 300 B2B SaaS companies over six years at different stages and market conditions. They codified these patterns and trends into a roadmap designed to create clarity, alignment, and serve as a tool for internal alignment across organizations.

real_qa.q: How many B2B SaaS companies has Refine Labs worked with over six years?
real_qa.r: Refine Labs has worked with over 300 B2B SaaS companies over the last six years at different stages and during different time periods as market conditions shifted.

real_qa.q: What improvement did Refine Labs see in retention rate after implementing people-first strategy?
real_qa.r: Since making investments in supporting people through tools, roles, and additional leadership layers in 2024 and beyond, Refine Labs has seen an over 50% improvement to their retention rate since the inception of the agency, while also continuing to improve revenue and profitability.

real_qa.q: What is Megan Bowen's core leadership lesson from running Refine Labs?
real_qa.r: One of Megan Bowen's big lessons has been 'don't say yes when you mean no.' real_qa.q: How often should companies conduct buyer research and market research to stay aligned?
real_qa.r: Megan Bowen recommends doing buyer research and market research approximately every six months because things are constantly changing for buyers. real_qa.q: What daily wellness practices does Megan Bowen maintain as CEO of Refine Labs?
